<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Shoreline — A Complete Buyer's Guide to Beach Property in the Philippines</title>
<meta name="description" content="A detailed, professional guide to buying beach property in the Philippines: locations, real costs, pros and cons, foreign-ownership law, and financial strategy.">
<style>
/* ============================================================
   SHORELINE — Philippine Beach Property Guide
   Design system
   ============================================================ */
:root{
  --navy:#0C2B44;
  --navy-2:#123A5A;
  --navy-3:#082238;
  --ink:#182A3B;
  --teal:#0F6E78;
  --teal-2:#2E97A6;
  --teal-soft:#E4F0F0;
  --gold:#C29A3B;
  --gold-2:#A87F24;
  --gold-soft:#F6EDD6;
  --sand:#F1EBDD;
  --ivory:#FAF8F2;
  --white:#FFFFFF;
  --line:rgba(12,43,68,.13);
  --line-soft:rgba(12,43,68,.07);
  --muted:#5C6B7A;
  --muted-light:#A9BACB;
  --green:#2E7D5B;
  --green-soft:#E4F0E9;
  --red:#B4433A;
  --red-soft:#F7E9E7;
  --radius:16px;
  --shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(12,43,68,.08);
  --shadow-lift:0 18px 44px rgba(12,43,68,.14);
  --font-display:"Playfair Display","Didot","Bodoni MT","Cochin",Georgia,"Times New Roman",serif;
  --font-body:"Avenir Next","Segoe UI",-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Inter",Roboto,"Helvetica Neue",Arial,sans-serif;
  --container:1120px;
}
*{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{
  font-family:var(--font-body);
  color:var(--ink);
  background:var(--ivory);
  line-height:1.65;
  font-size:16px;
  -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
}
img,svg{display:block;max-width:100%}
a{color:var(--teal);text-decoration:none}
a:hover{color:var(--teal-2)}
section{scroll-margin-top:84px}
.container{max-width:var(--container);margin:0 auto;padding:0 24px}
.muted{color:var(--muted)}
.small{font-size:.85rem}

/* ---------- Reading progress ---------- */
#progress{
  position:fixed;top:0;left:0;height:3px;width:0%;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--gold),#E3C06A);
  z-index:1200;transition:width .12s linear;
}

/* ---------- Header ---------- */
.site-header{
  position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:1000;
  transition:background .35s ease, box-shadow .35s ease, border-color .35s ease;
  border-bottom:1px solid transparent;
  background:transparent;
}
.site-header.scrolled{
  background:rgba(250,248,242,.94);
  backdrop-filter:blur(10px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(10px);
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-soft);
  box-shadow:0 4px 20px rgba(12,43,68,.06);
}
.nav-inner{
  max-width:var(--container);margin:0 auto;padding:0 24px;
  height:72px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:24px;
}
.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;color:#fff;transition:color .35s}
.site-header.scrolled .brand{color:var(--navy)}
.brand-mark{width:38px;height:38px;flex:none}
.brand-text{display:flex;flex-direction:column;line-height:1.15}
.brand-name{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:1.35rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.06em}
.brand-sub{font-size:.62rem;letter-spacing:.28em;text-transform:uppercase;opacity:.75}
#mainNav{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px}
#mainNav a{
  color:rgba(255,255,255,.85);font-size:.78rem;font-weight:600;
  letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:8px;
  transition:color .25s, background .25s;white-space:nowrap;
}
#mainNav a:hover{color:#fff;background:rgba(255,255,255,.12)}
.site-header.scrolled #mainNav a{color:var(--navy)}
.site-header.scrolled #mainNav a:hover{color:var(--teal);background:var(--teal-soft)}
.nav-toggle{
  display:none;background:none;border:0;cursor:pointer;padding:10px;
}
.nav-toggle span{
  display:block;width:24px;height:2px;background:#fff;margin:5px 0;border-radius:2px;
  transition:transform .3s, opacity .3s, background .35s;
}
.site-header.scrolled .nav-toggle span{background:var(--navy)}
.nav-toggle.active span:nth-child(1){transform:translateY(7px) rotate(45deg)}
.nav-toggle.active span:nth-child(2){opacity:0}
.nav-toggle.active span:nth-child(3){transform:translateY(-7px) rotate(-45deg)}
.nav-toggle.active span{background:var(--navy)}

/* ---------- Hero ---------- */
.hero{
  position:relative;min-height:100svh;display:flex;align-items:center;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,#071C2E 0%,#0B2E4A 42%,#0E5468 72%,#10767C 100%);
  overflow:hidden;color:#fff;
}
.hero-inner{
  position:relative;z-index:5;max-width:var(--container);margin:0 auto;
  padding:150px 24px 220px;width:100%;
}
.hero-sun{
  position:absolute;top:16%;right:14%;width:150px;height:150px;border-radius:50%;
  background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 45%,#F7DE9C 0%,#EDC15C 48%,rgba(237,193,92,.35) 68%,rgba(237,193,92,0) 72%);
  opacity:.95;z-index:1;
}
.hero-sun::after{
  content:"";position:absolute;inset:-60px;border-radius:50%;
  background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(237,193,92,.28) 0%,rgba(237,193,92,0) 70%);
}
.hero-eyebrow{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;
  font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:.32em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:#E9CE8B;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:26px;
}
.hero-eyebrow::before{content:"";width:44px;height:1px;background:var(--gold)}
.hero h1{
  font-family:var(--font-display);font-weight:700;
  font-size:clamp(2.6rem,6.2vw,4.7rem);line-height:1.08;
  max-width:15ch;letter-spacing:-.01em;margin-bottom:24px;
}
.hero h1 em{font-style:italic;color:#EFCF7E}
.hero-sub{
  max-width:56ch;font-size:clamp(1rem,1.5vw,1.16rem);
  color:rgba(233,240,245,.85);margin-bottom:40px;font-weight:400;
}
.hero-cta{display:flex;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.btn{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;
  padding:15px 30px;border-radius:999px;font-weight:700;font-size:.92rem;
  letter-spacing:.04em;transition:transform .25s, box-shadow .25s, background .25s, color .25s, border-color .25s;
  border:1px solid transparent;cursor:pointer;
}
.btn:hover{transform:translateY(-2px)}
.btn-gold{background:var(--gold);color:var(--navy-3)}
.btn-gold:hover{background:#D2A94C;box-shadow:0 12px 26px rgba(194,154,59,.35);color:var(--navy-3)}
.btn-ghost{background:transparent;color:#fff;border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.45)}
.btn-ghost:hover{border-color:#fff;background:rgba(255,255,255,.1)}
.btn-navy{background:var(--navy);color:#fff}
.btn-navy:hover{background:var(--navy-2)}
.hero-waves{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;height:190px;z-index:3;pointer-events:none}
.wave{
  position:absolute;left:0;right:0;background-repeat:repeat-x;background-size:1200px 100%;
}
.wave-1{
  bottom:70px;height:130px;opacity:.45;
  background-image:url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%201200%20140'%20preserveAspectRatio='none'%3E%3Cpath%20d='M0,80C200,30,400,120,600,80C800,40,1000,120,1200,80L1200,140L0,140Z'%20fill='%235FB8C4'/%3E%3C/svg%3E");
  animation:drift 26s linear infinite;
}
.wave-2{
  bottom:28px;height:120px;opacity:.75;
  background-image:url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%201200%20140'%20preserveAspectRatio='none'%3E%3Cpath%20d='M0,64C200,112,400,16,600,64C800,112,1000,16,1200,64L1200,140L0,140Z'%20fill='%232E97A6'/%3E%3C/svg%3E");
  animation:drift 17s linear infinite;
}
.wave-3{
  bottom:-3px;height:100px;
  background-image:url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%201200%20140'%20preserveAspectRatio='none'%3E%3Cpath%20d='M0,64C200,112,400,16,600,64C800,112,1000,16,1200,64L1200,140L0,140Z'%20fill='%23FAF8F2'/%3E%3C/svg%3E");
  animation:drift 11s linear infinite;
}
@keyframes drift{from{background-position-x:0}to{background-position-x:-1200px}}

/* ---------- Ticker ---------- */
.ticker{
  background:var(--navy-3);border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06);
  overflow:hidden;padding:14px 0;position:relative;z-index:4;
}
.ticker-track{display:flex;width:max-content;animation:ticker 40s linear infinite}
.ticker:hover .ticker-track{animation-play-state:paused}
.ticker-item{
  font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:.34em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:#D9BE7C;font-weight:600;padding:0 28px;white-space:nowrap;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:28px;
}
.ticker-item::after{content:"◆";font-size:.5rem;color:rgba(217,190,124,.5)}
@keyframes ticker{from{transform:translateX(0)}to{transform:translateX(-50%)}}

/* ---------- Sections ---------- */
.section{padding:96px 0}
.section-ivory{background:var(--ivory)}
.section-white{background:var(--white)}
.section-sand{background:var(--sand)}
.section-dark{
  background:
    radial-gradient(1000px 500px at 85% -10%, rgba(46,151,166,.18), transparent 60%),
    linear-gradient(180deg,var(--navy-3) 0%,var(--navy) 100%);
  color:#E9EEF3;
}
.section-dark .muted{color:var(--muted-light)}
.section-head{max-width:820px;margin-bottom:56px}
.eyebrow{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;
  font-size:.7rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.3em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--gold-2);margin-bottom:16px;
}
.eyebrow::before{content:"";width:36px;height:1px;background:var(--gold)}
.section-dark .eyebrow{color:#E0C06B}
.section-head h2{
  font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:clamp(1.9rem,3.6vw,2.8rem);
  line-height:1.15;letter-spacing:-.01em;color:var(--navy);margin-bottom:18px;font-weight:700;
}
.section-dark .section-head h2{color:#F4EFE3}
.lede{font-size:1.06rem;color:var(--muted);max-width:70ch}
.section-dark .lede{color:var(--muted-light)}

/* ---------- Stats ---------- */
.stats{
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(6,1fr);gap:1px;
  background:var(--line-soft);border:1px solid var(--line-soft);border-radius:var(--radius);
  overflow:hidden;margin-bottom:56px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);
}
.stat{background:var(--white);padding:26px 20px;text-align:center;transition:background .3s}
.stat:hover{background:var(--gold-soft)}
.stat-num{
  font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:1.7rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--navy);
  display:block;line-height:1.2;margin-bottom:6px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;
}
.stat-num .unit{font-size:.85rem;color:var(--gold-2)}
.stat-label{font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);font-weight:600}

/* ---------- Callouts ---------- */
.callout{
  border-left:4px solid var(--gold);background:var(--gold-soft);
  border-radius:0 14px 14px 0;padding:26px 30px;margin:40px 0;
  box-shadow:var(--shadow);
}
.callout h3{
  font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:1.25rem;color:var(--navy);margin-bottom:12px;
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;
}
.callout p, .callout li{color:#54503F;font-size:.98rem}
.callout ul{padding-left:20px;display:grid;gap:10px}
.callout li strong{color:var(--navy)}
.callout-dark{
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);border-left-color:var(--gold);
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);border-left:4px solid var(--gold);
  border-radius:0 14px 14px 0;
}
.callout-dark h3{color:#F1DFA9}
.callout-dark p, .callout-dark li{color:#C8D4DF}
.callout-dark li strong{color:#F4EFE3}

/* ---------- Persona cards ---------- */
.grid-4{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:20px}
.grid-3{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:20px}
.card{
  background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line-soft);border-radius:var(--radius);
  padding:28px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);transition:transform .3s, box-shadow .3s, border-color .3s;
}
.card:hover{transform:translateY(-5px);box-shadow:var(--shadow-lift);border-color:rgba(194,154,59,.4)}
.card .k{
  font-size:.68rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--gold-2);margin-bottom:10px;display:block;
}
.card h3{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:1.22rem;color:var(--navy);margin-bottom:10px;line-height:1.3}
.card p{font-size:.93rem;color:var(--muted)}
.card .tagline{font-family:var(--font-display);font-style:italic;font-size:1.02rem;color:var(--teal);margin-top:12px}

/* ---------- Location filters ---------- */
.filters{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:36px}
.chip{
  border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--white);border-radius:999px;
  padding:9px 20px;font-size:.8rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--muted);cursor:pointer;transition:all .25s;
}
.chip:hover{border-color:var(--gold);color:var(--navy)}
.chip.active{background:var(--navy);border-color:var(--navy);color:#fff}

/* ---------- Location cards ---------- */
.loc-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:22px}
.loc-card{
  background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line-soft);border-radius:var(--radius);
  overflow:hidden;box-shadow:var(--shadow);transition:transform .3s, box-shadow .3s, border-color .3s;
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;
}
.loc-card:hover{transform:translateY(-5px);box-shadow:var(--shadow-lift);border-color:rgba(194,154,59,.45)}
.loc-card.hide{display:none}
.loc-top{
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--navy) 0%,var(--teal) 130%);
  color:#fff;padding:24px 26px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;
}
.loc-top::after{
  content:"";position:absolute;right:-30px;bottom:-46px;width:150px;height:150px;border-radius:50%;
  background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(224,192,107,.28),transparent 70%);
}
.loc-name{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:1.42rem;font-weight:700;line-height:1.2}
.loc-region{font-size:.78rem;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#BFDCDF;margin-top:4px}
.tier-badge{
  position:absolute;top:22px;right:22px;font-size:.64rem;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.14em;
  text-transform:uppercase;padding:6px 12px;border-radius:999px;z-index:2;
}
.tier-badge.premium{background:var(--gold);color:var(--navy-3)}
.tier-badge.mid{background:rgba(255,255,255,.18);color:#fff;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.4)}
.tier-badge.value{background:rgba(46,125,91,.35);color:#DFF2E7;border:1px solid rgba(223,242,231,.5)}
.loc-body{padding:24px 26px 26px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:16px;flex:1}
.loc-tag{font-family:var(--font-display);font-style:italic;font-size:1.05rem;color:var(--teal);line-height:1.45}
.loc-price{
  display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px 22px;padding:14px 16px;background:var(--ivory);
  border:1px solid var(--line-soft);border-radius:12px;
}
.loc-price div{font-size:.85rem}
.loc-price .lab{display:block;font-size:.64rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:2px}
.loc-price strong{color:var(--navy);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.ratings{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,auto);gap:8px 20px;justify-content:space-between}
.rating{font-size:.72rem;color:var(--muted);font-weight:600}
.dots{display:flex;gap:4px;margin-top:4px}
.dot{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:#D8D3C4}
.dot.on{background:var(--gold)}
.loc-lists{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px;font-size:.85rem}
.loc-lists h4{
  font-size:.66rem;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:8px;
}
.loc-lists .pro h4{color:var(--green)}
.loc-lists .con h4{color:var(--red)}
.loc-lists ul{list-style:none;display:grid;gap:6px}
.loc-lists li{padding-left:16px;position:relative;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.45}
.loc-lists .pro li::before{content:"—";position:absolute;left:0;color:var(--green)}
.loc-lists .con li::before{content:"—";position:absolute;left:0;color:var(--red)}
.loc-best{
  margin-top:auto;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;font-size:.84rem;
  padding-top:14px;border-top:1px dashed var(--line);
}
.loc-best b{color:var(--gold-2);font-size:.66rem;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;flex:none}
.loc-best span{color:var(--ink)}

/* ---------- Tables ---------- */
.table-wrap{
  overflow-x:auto;border:1px solid var(--line-soft);border-radius:var(--radius);
  background:var(--white);box-shadow:var(--shadow);margin:24px 0 12px;
}
table.tbl{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;min-width:640px;font-size:.92rem}
.tbl caption{
  text-align:left;padding:18px 24px 6px;font-family:var(--font-display);
  font-size:1.15rem;color:var(--navy);font-weight:700;
}
.tbl th{
  text-align:left;font-size:.68rem;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--navy);background:var(--sand);padding:14px 24px;border-bottom:2px solid var(--gold);
  white-space:nowrap;
}
.section-dark .tbl th{background:var(--sand);color:var(--navy);border-bottom-color:var(--gold)}
.tbl td{padding:14px 24px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-soft);vertical-align:top;color:var(--ink)}
.section-dark .tbl td{color:var(--ink);border-bottom-color:var(--line-soft)}
.tbl tr:last-child td{border-bottom:0}
.tbl tbody tr{transition:background .2s}
.tbl tbody tr:hover{background:var(--gold-soft)}
.section-dark .tbl tbody tr:hover{background:var(--gold-soft)}
.tbl td strong{color:var(--navy)}
.section-dark .tbl td strong{color:var(--navy)}
.tbl .num{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;white-space:nowrap}
.tbl-note{font-size:.8rem;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:32px}

/* ---------- Budget scenarios ---------- */
.scen-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:18px;margin-top:8px}
.scen{
  background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line-soft);border-top:4px solid var(--gold);
  border-radius:14px;padding:22px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);transition:transform .3s, box-shadow .3s;
}
.scen:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:var(--shadow-lift)}
.scen .amt{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:1.3rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--navy);margin-bottom:10px}
.scen p{font-size:.85rem;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.55}

/* ---------- Calculator ---------- */
.calc{
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.05fr .95fr;gap:0;margin-top:16px;
  border:1px solid var(--line-soft);border-radius:var(--radius);overflow:hidden;box-shadow:var(--shadow);
}
.calc-controls{background:var(--white);padding:34px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:26px}
.calc-field label{
  display:block;font-size:.7rem;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--navy);margin-bottom:10px;
}
.calc-field select{
  width:100%;padding:12px 14px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;background:var(--ivory);
  font-family:var(--font-body);font-size:.95rem;color:var(--ink);cursor:pointer;
}
.calc-field select:focus{outline:2px solid var(--gold);outline-offset:1px}
.calc-field .range-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:10px}
.calc-field .range-val{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:1.5rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--teal);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
input[type="range"]{
  -webkit-appearance:none;appearance:none;width:100%;height:6px;border-radius:3px;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--gold) 0%,var(--teal-2) 100%);outline:none;cursor:pointer;
}
input[type="range"]::-webkit-slider-thumb{
  -webkit-appearance:none;appearance:none;width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:50%;
  background:var(--navy);border:3px solid #fff;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(12,43,68,.35);cursor:grab;
}
input[type="range"]::-moz-range-thumb{
  width:20px;height:20px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--navy);border:3px solid #fff;
  box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(12,43,68,.35);cursor:grab;
}
.calc-output{
  background:linear-gradient(160deg,var(--navy) 0%,var(--teal) 140%);color:#fff;
  padding:34px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;gap:14px;
}
.calc-line{font-size:.98rem;color:rgba(233,240,245,.9)}
.calc-line.big{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:clamp(1.5rem,2.6vw,2.1rem);font-weight:700;color:#F4E3AC;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.calc-line strong{color:#fff}
.calc-note{font-size:.75rem;color:rgba(233,240,245,.6);border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15);padding-top:14px;margin-top:4px}
.calc-title{
  font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:1.25rem;color:var(--navy);margin:44px 0 4px;font-weight:700;
}
.calc-sub{color:var(--muted);font-size:.92rem;margin-bottom:18px}

/* ---------- Waikiki focus ---------- */
.wk-compare{
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.2fr .8fr;gap:0;margin:8px 0 26px;
  border:1px solid var(--line-soft);border-radius:var(--radius);overflow:hidden;box-shadow:var(--shadow);
}
.wk-left{background:var(--white);padding:28px 32px}
.wk-right{
  background:linear-gradient(160deg,var(--navy) 0%,var(--teal) 140%);color:#fff;
  padding:28px 32px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;gap:18px;
}
.wk-para{font-size:.95rem;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.65;margin-bottom:18px}
.wk-para strong{color:var(--navy)}
.wk-list{list-style:none;display:grid;gap:14px}
.wk-list li{position:relative;padding-left:22px;font-size:.92rem;color:var(--ink);line-height:1.55}
.wk-list li::before{
  content:"";position:absolute;left:2px;top:9px;width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:2px;
  background:var(--gold);transform:rotate(45deg);
}
.wk-list li strong{color:var(--navy)}
.wk-head{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:1.1rem;color:#F4E3AC;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:14px}
.wk-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px;font-size:.9rem;padding:9px 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12)}
.wk-row:last-child{border-bottom:0}
.wk-row .lab{color:rgba(255,255,255,.65)}
.wk-row .val{font-weight:700;color:#fff;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;text-align:right}
.wk-row .val em{font-style:normal;color:#EFCF7E}
.wk-rank{display:grid;gap:14px}
.wk-card{
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:70px 1fr;gap:22px;background:var(--white);
  border:1px solid var(--line-soft);border-radius:var(--radius);padding:24px 26px;
  box-shadow:var(--shadow);transition:transform .3s, box-shadow .3s;
}
.wk-card:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:var(--shadow-lift)}
.wk-medal{
  width:64px;height:64px;border-radius:50%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  color:#fff;font-weight:800;flex:none;
}
.wk-medal .m{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:1.5rem;line-height:1}
.wk-medal .t{font-size:.52rem;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-top:3px;opacity:.85}
.wk-medal.gold{background:linear-gradient(140deg,#D2A94C,#A87F24);box-shadow:0 6px 16px rgba(168,127,36,.35)}
.wk-medal.silver{background:linear-gradient(140deg,#9AA7B4,#6E7E8E)}
.wk-medal.bronze{background:linear-gradient(140deg,#B57F4B,#8C5A2E)}
.wk-rank-body h3{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:1.28rem;color:var(--navy);margin-bottom:4px;line-height:1.25}
.wk-place{font-size:.74rem;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--teal);font-weight:700;margin-bottom:8px}
.wk-why{font-size:.9rem;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.6;margin-bottom:10px}
.wk-stats{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px 22px;font-size:.8rem}
.wk-stats div{white-space:nowrap}
.wk-stats .lab{display:block;font-size:.6rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.13em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:1px}
.wk-stats strong{color:var(--navy);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.wk-match{
  margin-top:8px;font-size:.78rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.05em;
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:5px 13px;border-radius:999px;
}
.wk-match .bar{width:74px;height:5px;border-radius:3px;background:var(--sand);overflow:hidden}
.wk-match .bar i{display:block;height:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--gold),#E3C06A);border-radius:3px}
.wk-match.a{background:var(--gold-soft);color:var(--gold-2)}
.wk-match.b{background:var(--teal-soft);color:var(--teal)}
.wk-match.c{background:var(--sand);color:var(--muted)}
.wk-caveat{margin-top:22px;font-size:.85rem;color:var(--muted);font-style:italic;line-height:1.6}

/* ---------- Pros & cons ---------- */
.pc-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:24px}
.pc-card{
  border-radius:var(--radius);padding:32px;border:1px solid var(--line-soft);
  background:var(--white);box-shadow:var(--shadow);
}
.pc-card.pros{border-top:5px solid var(--green)}
.pc-card.cons{border-top:5px solid var(--red)}
.pc-card h3{
  font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:1.5rem;margin-bottom:22px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;
}
.pc-card.pros h3{color:var(--green)}
.pc-card.cons h3{color:var(--red)}
.pc-icon{
  width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  font-size:1rem;font-weight:800;color:#fff;flex:none;
}
.pc-card.pros .pc-icon{background:var(--green)}
.pc-card.cons .pc-icon{background:var(--red)}
.pc-item{padding:14px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-soft)}
.pc-item:last-child{border-bottom:0;padding-bottom:0}
.pc-item:first-of-type{padding-top:0}
.pc-item strong{color:var(--navy);display:block;margin-bottom:4px;font-size:.98rem}
.pc-item p{font-size:.9rem;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.6}

/* ---------- Legal (dark) ---------- */
.titles-dl{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:16px;margin:28px 0}
.title-item{
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.045);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);
  border-radius:14px;padding:20px 22px;transition:border-color .3s, background .3s;
}
.title-item:hover{border-color:rgba(224,192,107,.5);background:rgba(255,255,255,.07)}
.title-item dt{
  font-weight:800;color:#EFD9A0;font-size:.9rem;letter-spacing:.04em;margin-bottom:6px;
}
.title-item dd{font-size:.86rem;color:#B9C7D4;line-height:1.55}
.timeline{position:relative;margin:36px 0;padding-left:0;list-style:none;counter-reset:step}
.timeline::before{
  content:"";position:absolute;left:23px;top:14px;bottom:14px;width:2px;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--gold),rgba(224,192,107,.15));
}
.tl-step{position:relative;padding:0 0 30px 70px}
.tl-step:last-child{padding-bottom:0}
.tl-num{
  position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:50%;
  background:var(--navy-3);border:2px solid var(--gold);color:#EFD9A0;
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  font-family:var(--font-display);font-weight:700;font-size:1.1rem;z-index:2;
}
.tl-step h4{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:1.12rem;color:#F4EFE3;margin-bottom:6px;padding-top:12px}
.tl-step p{font-size:.9rem;color:#B9C7D4;max-width:68ch}
.tl-step p strong{color:#EFD9A0;font-weight:600}
.redflags{
  background:rgba(180,67,58,.1);border:1px solid rgba(180,67,58,.4);border-radius:var(--radius);
  padding:30px 32px;margin-top:40px;
}
.redflags h3{
  font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:1.35rem;color:#F0B9B3;margin-bottom:18px;
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;
}
.redflags ol{padding-left:22px;display:grid;gap:12px}
.redflags li{font-size:.92rem;color:#D9C7C4;line-height:1.55;padding-left:6px}
.redflags li strong{color:#F4D8D4}
.legal-h3{
  font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:1.55rem;color:#F4EFE3;margin:56px 0 14px;font-weight:700;
}
.legal-h3:first-of-type{margin-top:0}
.legal-p{font-size:.98rem;color:#C4D0DC;max-width:78ch;margin-bottom:14px}
.legal-p strong{color:#F4EFE3}
.bullet-list{padding-left:0;list-style:none;display:grid;gap:12px;margin:18px 0}
.bullet-list li{position:relative;padding-left:26px;font-size:.95rem;color:#C4D0DC;line-height:1.6}
.bullet-list li::before{
  content:"◆";position:absolute;left:0;top:2px;color:var(--gold);font-size:.65rem;
}
.bullet-list li strong{color:#F4EFE3}
.section-light .bullet-list li{color:var(--muted)}
.section-light .bullet-list li strong{color:var(--navy)}

/* ---------- Finance ---------- */
.fin-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:22px}
.fin-card{
  background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line-soft);border-radius:var(--radius);
  padding:30px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);transition:transform .3s, box-shadow .3s;
}
.fin-card:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:var(--shadow-lift)}
.fin-card .fin-k{
  width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:12px;background:var(--teal-soft);color:var(--teal);
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:1.2rem;margin-bottom:16px;font-weight:700;
}
.fin-card h3{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:1.25rem;color:var(--navy);margin-bottom:10px}
.fin-card p, .fin-card li{font-size:.92rem;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.6}
.fin-card ul{padding-left:20px;display:grid;gap:8px;margin-top:10px}
.fin-card strong{color:var(--navy)}
.tips{
  margin-top:44px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--gold-soft),#FBF6E7);
  border:1px solid rgba(194,154,59,.35);border-radius:var(--radius);padding:34px;
}
.tips h3{
  font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:1.4rem;color:var(--navy);margin-bottom:20px;
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;
}
.tip-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:14px 30px}
.tip{display:flex;gap:14px;font-size:.92rem;color:#4E4A3A;line-height:1.55}
.tip .n{
  flex:none;width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--gold);color:var(--navy-3);
  font-weight:800;font-size:.85rem;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
}
.tip strong{color:var(--navy)}

/* ---------- Roadmap ---------- */
.road-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:18px}
.road-step{
  background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line-soft);border-radius:14px;padding:24px;
  box-shadow:var(--shadow);position:relative;transition:transform .3s, box-shadow .3s;
}
.road-step:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:var(--shadow-lift)}
.road-when{
  font-size:.64rem;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold-2);
  display:block;margin-bottom:8px;
}
.road-step h4{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:1.1rem;color:var(--navy);margin-bottom:8px}
.road-step p{font-size:.86rem;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.55}

/* ---------- Checklist ---------- */
.check-panel{
  max-width:820px;margin:0 auto;background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line-soft);
  border-radius:var(--radius);box-shadow:var(--shadow);overflow:hidden;
}
.check-header{
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--navy),var(--teal));color:#fff;padding:28px 34px;
}
.check-header h3{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:1.35rem;margin-bottom:6px}
.check-header p{font-size:.88rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,.75)}
.check-progress{padding:20px 34px 0}
.check-bar-track{height:8px;background:var(--sand);border-radius:4px;overflow:hidden}
.check-bar{
  height:100%;width:0%;border-radius:4px;transition:width .4s ease;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--gold),#E3C06A);
}
.check-meta{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-top:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px}
.check-count{font-size:.8rem;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--navy)}
.check-reset{
  background:none;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;padding:6px 16px;
  font-size:.74rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);cursor:pointer;
  transition:all .25s;
}
.check-reset:hover{border-color:var(--red);color:var(--red)}
.check-list{padding:22px 34px 30px}
.check-item{
  display:flex;gap:14px;align-items:flex-start;padding:13px 14px;border-radius:12px;cursor:pointer;
  transition:background .25s;border:1px solid transparent;
}
.check-item:hover{background:var(--ivory)}
.check-item input{
  appearance:none;-webkit-appearance:none;flex:none;width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:6px;
  border:2px solid #C9C2B0;background:#fff;cursor:pointer;position:relative;margin-top:2px;
  transition:all .2s;
}
.check-item input:checked{background:var(--gold);border-color:var(--gold)}
.check-item input:checked::after{
  content:"✓";position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  color:var(--navy-3);font-weight:800;font-size:.85rem;
}
.check-item input:checked + span{color:var(--muted);text-decoration:line-through;text-decoration-color:rgba(194,154,59,.6)}
.check-item span{font-size:.93rem;color:var(--ink);line-height:1.5;transition:color .2s}
.check-msg{
  margin:0 34px 30px;padding:16px 20px;background:var(--gold-soft);border-radius:12px;
  font-size:.9rem;color:#54503F;border-left:3px solid var(--gold);
}

/* ---------- FAQ ---------- */
.faq-wrap{max-width:860px;margin:0 auto}
.faq-item{
  background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line-soft);border-radius:14px;
  margin-bottom:14px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:var(--shadow);transition:border-color .3s;
}
.faq-item.open{border-color:rgba(194,154,59,.5)}
.faq-q{
  width:100%;background:none;border:0;cursor:pointer;text-align:left;
  padding:22px 26px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:18px;
  font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:1.08rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--navy);line-height:1.35;
}
.faq-q:hover{color:var(--teal)}
.faq-icon{
  flex:none;width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--gold-soft);color:var(--gold-2);
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:1.05rem;font-weight:700;
  transition:transform .3s, background .3s, color .3s;font-family:var(--font-body);
}
.faq-item.open .faq-icon{transform:rotate(45deg);background:var(--gold);color:var(--navy-3)}
.faq-a{max-height:0;overflow:hidden;transition:max-height .45s ease}
.faq-a-inner{padding:0 26px 24px;font-size:.94rem;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.7}
.faq-a-inner strong{color:var(--navy)}
.faq-a-inner ul{padding-left:20px;margin-top:10px;display:grid;gap:6px}

/* ---------- Glossary ---------- */
.gloss-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:14px}
.gloss{
  background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line-soft);border-left:3px solid var(--gold);
  border-radius:12px;padding:18px 22px;
}
.gloss dt{font-weight:800;color:var(--navy);font-size:.92rem;letter-spacing:.02em;margin-bottom:4px}
.gloss dd{font-size:.86rem;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.55}

/* ---------- Footer ---------- */
.site-footer{background:var(--navy-3);color:#A9BACB;padding:72px 0 0}
.foot-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.4fr 1fr 1fr;gap:48px;padding-bottom:52px}
.foot-brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;color:#F4EFE3;margin-bottom:18px}
.foot-brand .brand-name{color:#F4EFE3}
.site-footer p{font-size:.88rem;line-height:1.7}
.site-footer h4{
  font-size:.7rem;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:#EFD9A0;margin-bottom:18px;
}
.foot-links{list-style:none;display:grid;gap:10px}
.foot-links a{color:#A9BACB;font-size:.9rem;transition:color .25s}
.foot-links a:hover{color:#F4EFE3}
.foot-bottom{
  border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);padding:22px 0;
  display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;
}
.foot-bottom p{font-size:.78rem;color:#6E8299}
.foot-disclaimer{
  font-size:.75rem;color:#6E8299;line-height:1.7;padding-bottom:26px;max-width:900px;
}

/* ---------- Back to top ---------- */
.to-top{
  position:fixed;right:24px;bottom:24px;width:50px;height:50px;border-radius:50%;
  background:var(--navy);color:#fff;border:0;cursor:pointer;font-size:1.15rem;z-index:900;
  box-shadow:0 10px 26px rgba(12,43,68,.35);opacity:0;transform:translateY(14px);pointer-events:none;
  transition:opacity .35s, transform .35s, background .3s;
}
.to-top.show{opacity:1;transform:none;pointer-events:auto}
.to-top:hover{background:var(--teal)}

/* ---------- Reveal ---------- */
.reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(26px);transition:opacity .7s ease, transform .7s ease}
.reveal.in{opacity:1;transform:none}

/* ---------- Focus ---------- */
a:focus-visible,button:focus-visible,select:focus-visible,input:focus-visible{
  outline:2px solid var(--gold);outline-offset:2px;
}

/* ---------- Responsive ---------- */
@media (max-width:1080px){
  .stats{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}
  .grid-4{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
  .scen-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
  .road-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
}
@media (max-width:900px){
  .nav-toggle{display:block}
  #mainNav{
    position:fixed;top:72px;left:0;right:0;flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch;gap:0;
    background:rgba(250,248,242,.98);backdrop-filter:blur(12px);
    border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding:10px 20px 20px;
    transform:translateY(-12px);opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:all .3s ease;
    box-shadow:0 20px 40px rgba(12,43,68,.15);
  }
  #mainNav.open{transform:none;opacity:1;pointer-events:auto}
  #mainNav a{color:var(--navy)!important;padding:14px 10px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-soft)}
  .loc-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .pc-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .fin-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .calc{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .titles-dl{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .gloss-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .foot-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:34px}
  .section{padding:72px 0}
  .hero-inner{padding:130px 24px 200px}
  .hero-sun{top:10%;right:8%;width:110px;height:110px}
  .tip-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
}
@media (max-width:640px){
  .stats{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
  .grid-4{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .scen-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .road-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .loc-lists{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .ratings{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
  .hero h1{max-width:100%}
  .foot-bottom{flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start}
  .check-list{padding:18px 20px 26px}
  .check-msg{margin:0 20px 26px}
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  *,*::before,*::after{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}
  html{scroll-behavior:auto}
  .reveal{opacity:1;transform:none}
}
</style>

<!-- ================= OVERVIEW ================= -->
<section class="section section-ivory" id="overview">
  <div class="container">
    <div class="section-head reveal">
      <span class="eyebrow">01 — The big picture</span>
      <h2>Why the Philippines, and why beachfront?</h2>
      <p class="lede">The Philippines is a 7,641-island archipelago on the Pacific — a tropical market
      where world-class coastline, a dollar-pegged cost base, an English-speaking business culture and
      strong tourism fundamentals meet. For a buyer, that combination is rare: you get an asset that is
      both a lifestyle and an investment, at a price point a fraction of North American, Australian or
      Southern European beachfront.</p>
    </div>

    <div class="stats reveal" role="list">
      <div class="stat" role="listitem"><span class="stat-num">7,641</span><span class="stat-label">Islands in the archipelago</span></div>
      <div class="stat" role="listitem"><span class="stat-num">37,000<span class="unit"> km</span></span><span class="stat-label">Of coastline</span></div>
      <div class="stat" role="listitem"><span class="stat-num">C$900–21k</span><span class="stat-label">Price range per m², beachfront land</span></div>
      <div class="stat" role="listitem"><span class="stat-num">40<span class="unit">%</span></span><span class="stat-label">Foreign ownership cap on condos</span></div>
      <div class="stat" role="listitem"><span class="stat-num">50<span class="unit"> yrs</span></span><span class="stat-label">Max renewable lease for foreigners</span></div>
      <div class="stat" role="listitem"><span class="stat-num">4–8<span class="unit">%</span></span><span class="stat-label">Typical net rental yield in resort towns</span></div>
    </div>

    <div class="grid-4">
      <div class="card reveal">
        <span class="k">For the retiree</span>
        <h3>Slow life, serious value</h3>
        <p>Retiree visas (SRRV, 9G) pair with a cost of living a fraction of Western countries. The sweet
        spot for a well-placed condo or small villa is roughly <strong>C$200k–C$750k</strong>, with
        world-class beaches within walking distance of your door.</p>
        <p class="tagline">"Buy the view; the numbers take care of themselves."</p>
      </div>
      <div class="card reveal">
        <span class="k">For the investor</span>
        <h3>Yield plus appreciation</h3>
        <p>Mature resort towns (Boracay, Mactan) deliver liquidity and steady short-term rental demand;
        emerging towns (El Nido, Siargao, Panglao) offer the appreciation story. A portfolio of
        <strong>C$450k–C$3M</strong> can span both strategies.</p>
        <p class="tagline">"Pair a cash-flow asset with a land-bank asset."</p>
      </div>
      <div class="card reveal">
        <span class="k">For the second-home buyer</span>
        <h3>A family escape</h3>
        <p>If you plan 3–5 visits a year, target locations within a 6–10 hour flight and with reliable
        short-stay rental rules so the property earns when you're away. <strong>C$350k–C$1.5M</strong> buys a
        serious beach villa with pool in most mid-market towns.</p>
        <p class="tagline">"Liquidity at exit starts with the entry decision."</p>
      </div>
      <div class="card reveal">
        <span class="k">For the diaspora Filipino</span>
        <h3>Heritage meets investment</h3>
        <p>Overseas Filipinos are the market's strongest buyer class — they can own land outright,
        navigate family and title matters, and benefit from deep local knowledge. Buy in your home
        province's beach corridor and you inherit a maintenance network.</p>
        <p class="tagline">"The family that builds together, keeps the land."</p>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="callout reveal">
      <h3>⚓ Key takeaways before you read on</h3>
      <ul>
        <li><strong>Foreigners cannot own land</strong> — but they can own condominiums outright (up to the 40% cap), lease land for up to 50 + 25 years, or hold property through a genuinely 60%-Filipino corporation.</li>
        <li><strong>Budget 5–10% above the purchase price</strong> for capital-gains, documentary and transfer taxes, registration, notary and professional fees — then add construction and a one-to-two-year holding reserve.</li>
        <li><strong>Never rely on a Tax Declaration.</strong> Insist on a clean Transfer Certificate of Title verified at the Registry of Deeds, with a full title search, litigation search and independent survey.</li>
        <li><strong>Build for the typhoons.</strong> Engineering, elevation and insurance determine both your safety and your insurability — and therefore your resale value.</li>
        <li><strong>Exit is part of entry.</strong> The resale market is thin and patient; plan your liquidity story before you buy, not after.</li>
      </ul>
    </div>
  </div>

<section class="section section-sand" id="waikiki">
  <div class="container">
    <div class="section-head reveal">
      <span class="eyebrow">03 — The Waikiki equation</span>
      <h2>What Waikiki actually feels like — and where you can buy it</h2>
      <p class="lede">Most people who describe "Waikiki weather" are really describing something more
      specific: a year-round island climate in which <strong>air temperatures sit between roughly
      25 and 31 °C (77–88 °F) for twelve months, humidity stays high, sea temperatures stay
      swimmable, and the "rainy" season is a period of short, heavy afternoon showers rather than
      cold or wet months</strong>. Hawaii itself is a bit cooler than that — its cool-season
      afternoons hover near 26–27 °C with trade winds keeping it breezy. The Philippines, sitting
      closer to the equator, is actually <em>warmer</em> than Waikiki in the winter; the real
      differences are humidity, monsoon rhythm and storm risk. That is precisely why the right
      comparison is not "beach" but "climate and feel."</p>
    </div>

    <div class="wk-compare reveal">
      <div class="wk-left">
        <p class="wk-para">Waikiki's annual weather, distilled:</p>
        <ul class="wk-list">
          <li><strong>Air:</strong> 77–88 °F (25–31 °C) year-round; the "cool" January afternoons are still beach weather.</li>
          <li><strong>Sea:</strong> 77–80 °F (25–27 °C) all year — swimable in every month, no wetsuit ever.</li>
          <li><strong>Rain:</strong> roughly 23 inches (580 mm) per year, mostly as brief showers — an average of ~60 wet days of light rain, almost none of it prolonged.</li>
          <li><strong>Storms:</strong> the big surprise — hurricane season affects Oahu only from the edges (Aug–Oct); major storm damage is rare on the island.</li>
          <li><strong>Feel:</strong> warm, humid, breezy by the trade winds; UV is high; evenings are short (6–7 h of daylight in winter).</li>
        </ul>
      </div>
      <div class="wk-right">
        <div class="wk-head">Waikiki vs. the Philippine tropical belt</div>
        <div class="wk-row"><span class="lab">Annual high, typical</span><span class="val">88 °F / 31 °C <em>≈ same</em></span></div>
        <div class="wk-row"><span class="lab">Annual low, typical</span><span class="val">74 °F / 23 °C <em>≈ same</em></span></div>
        <div class="wk-row"><span class="lab">Sea temperature</span><span class="val">77–84 °F / 25–29 °C <em>≈ same or warmer</em></span></div>
        <div class="wk-row"><span class="lab">Rainy months</span><span class="val">12 months <em>vs. 6–7 heavy monsoon months</em></span></div>
        <div class="wk-row"><span class="lab">Severe storm risk</span><span class="val"><em>Low in Hawaii · High in the PH typhoon belt</em></span></div>
        <div class="wk-row"><span class="lab">Humidity feel</span><span class="val"><em>Moderate (trades) · Higher inland & wet season</em></span></div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="wk-compare reveal">
      <div class="wk-left">
        <p class="wk-para"><strong>Two honest caveats before you fall in love with the comparison.</strong>
        First, no Philippine beach is storm-free: the typhoon belt is the price of admission for
        warmer-than-Waikiki temperatures, and engineering, insurance and site elevation are how you
        manage that (see the Finance section). Second, "dry season" in the Visayas and Luzon
        (roughly Nov–May) genuinely mirrors Waikiki's feel — short showers, high sun, warm sea — and
        it is the season most buyers should test-drive before buying.</p>
        <p class="wk-para">With that understood, here is the ranking of the twelve locations on this
        guide against the Waikiki benchmark: air and sea temperature, humidity comfort, storm
        exposure, and the character of the beach itself.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="wk-right">
        <div class="wk-head">How to read the scores</div>
        <div class="wk-row"><span class="lab">Temperature fit</span><span class="val">How close to 77–88 °F year-round</span></div>
        <div class="wk-row"><span class="lab">Humidity comfort</span><span class="val">Breeziness vs. mugginess</span></div>
        <div class="wk-row"><span class="lab">Storm exposure</span><span class="val">Typhoon belt vs. leeward shelter</span></div>
        <div class="wk-row"><span class="lab">Beach character</span><span class="val">Waikiki-style: flat, swimmable, white sand</span></div>
        <div class="wk-row"><span class="lab">Overall match</span><span class="val">Weighted, storm-risk adjusted</span></div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <h3 class="calc-title reveal" style="margin-top:36px">The ranking — closest to Waikiki, first</h3>
    <div class="wk-rank">

      <div class="wk-card reveal">
        <div class="wk-medal gold"><span class="m">1</span><span class="t">Best match</span></div>
        <div class="wk-rank-body">
          <h3>Siargao — Surigao del Norte</h3>
          <p class="wk-place">Mindanao · 9.6° N — the closest latitude of the twelve, north of the main typhoon belt</p>
          <p class="wk-why">At 9.6° N, Siargao is the Philippines' most equatorial major beach market and
          the one whose annual temperature curve most closely tracks Waikiki's: highs hold near 31–33 °C
          (88–91 °F) all year with almost no seasonal swing, and the sea sits at 28–29 °C (82–84 °F) —
          consistently <em>warmer</em> than Oahu. Being north of the core West-Pacific typhoon track, it
          also misses many of the systems that hammer the Visayas, though 2022 and 2024 proved the belt
          can still find it. Swaying coconut palms, white sand and a flat, swimmable lagoon at
          Cloud 9 give it the closest visual and sensory match of any spot on this list.</p>
          <div class="wk-stats">
            <div><span class="lab">Air (high)</span><strong>31–33 °C year-round</strong></div>
            <div><span class="lab">Sea</span><strong>28–29 °C (82–84 °F)</strong></div>
            <div><span class="lab">Wet months</span><strong>Jun–Nov, heavy</strong></div>
            <div><span class="lab">Storm exposure</span><strong>Below average</strong></div>
          </div>
          <span class="wk-match a">92% match <span class="bar"><i style="width:92%"></i></span></span>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="wk-card reveal">
        <div class="wk-medal silver"><span class="m">2</span><span class="t">Runner-up</span></div>
        <div class="wk-rank-body">
          <h3>Boracay — Aklan</h3>
          <p class="wk-place">Panay Island · 11.9° N — the classic white-sand beach experience</p>
          <p class="wk-why">Boracay delivers the Waikiki <em>look</em> more completely than anywhere else
          here: long, flat stretches of white powder sand, a calm lagoon on the west side that is
          swimmable in all but the strongest weather, and a resort infrastructure that matches a
          mature beach destination. Its Panay location is also somewhat sheltered from the strongest
          typhoons, and the 2018 rehabilitation cleaned up both the beach and the water. Highs run
          31–33 °C (88–91 °F); the sea averages 28–29 °C (82–84 °F). The trade-off: Boracay is
          genuinely hot and humid in the wet months, and it is the most crowded, most expensive
          "postcard" on the list.</p>
          <div class="wk-stats">
            <div><span class="lab">Air (high)</span><strong>31–33 °C (88–91 °F)</strong></div>
            <div><span class="lab">Sea</span><strong>28–29 °C (82–84 °F)</strong></div>
            <div><span class="lab">Wet months</span><strong>Jun–Nov, heavy</strong></div>
            <div><span class="lab">Storm exposure</span><strong>Moderate</strong></div>
          </div>
          <span class="wk-match a">88% match <span class="bar"><i style="width:88%"></i></span></span>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="wk-card reveal">
        <div class="wk-medal bronze"><span class="m">3</span><span class="t">Third</span></div>
        <div class="wk-rank-body">
          <h3>Mactan — Cebu</h3>
          <p class="wk-place">Central Visayas · 10.3° N — the most livable "resort city" beach</p>
          <p class="wk-why">If the Waikiki you love is the <em>lifestyle</em> — walkable resorts,
          international flights, reliable utilities, a cosmopolitan feel — Mactan is the closest
          analogue in the Philippines. Climate-wise it tracks the standard tropical pattern: highs of
          31–33 °C (88–91 °F), a sea at 28–29 °C (82–84 °F), and a wet season (Jun–Nov) that is
          real but mostly afternoon-heavy. It sits squarely in the typhoon belt, so storm risk is a
          genuine planning factor; in exchange you get the best services, medical care and daily
          convenience of any beach market in the country. Many buyers treat Mactan as their
          "Waikiki" and pair it with a hotter, cheaper second island.</p>
          <div class="wk-stats">
            <div><span class="lab">Air (high)</span><strong>31–33 °C (88–91 °F)</strong></div>
            <div><span class="lab">Sea</span><strong>28–29 °C (82–84 °F)</strong></div>
            <div><span class="lab">Wet months</span><strong>Jun–Nov</strong></div>
            <div><span class="lab">Storm exposure</span><strong>Average (typhoon belt)</strong></div>
          </div>
          <span class="wk-match b">84% match <span class="bar"><i style="width:84%"></i></span></span>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="wk-card reveal">
        <div class="wk-rank-body" style="grid-column:1/-1">
          <h3>The rest of the table</h3>
          <p class="wk-why" style="margin-bottom:14px">Ranked by overall match. The pattern: the
          further north and the better the leeward shelter, the closer the feel — but also the more
          typhoon-prone. The southern and eastern islands trade a touch of heat for a longer, drier
          "Waikiki-like" window.</p>
          <div class="wk-stats" style="gap:10px 28px">
            <div><span class="lab">4 · El Nido</span><strong>81% — stunning, but Palawan's wet season is the heaviest here; leeward bays stay calm</strong></div>

      <h3>⚓ The Waikiki verdict</h3>
      <ul>
        <li><strong>Closest overall feel: Siargao</strong> — warmest year-round air, warmest seas, and a typhoon track that mostly misses it. Budget mid-market land at C$3,000–C$9,500/m², or a turnkey villa from C$350k.</li>
        <li><strong>Closest visual match: Boracay</strong> — the white-sand, lagoon-flat beach that most "Waikiki photos" are imitating. Land C$5,000–C$12,000/m²; condos C$5,000–C$13,500/m².</li>
        <li><strong>Closest lifestyle match: Mactan</strong> — the resort-city walkability, international airport and services of Waikiki, minus the volcano and the trade-wind breeze. Land C$4,500–C$16,000/m².</li>

      <h2>The full cost of beachfront, item by item</h2>
      <p class="lede">The sticker price is only the beginning. A complete budget covers the purchase price,
      the one-time transfer costs (which in the Philippines can total 8–10% of the price when the seller
      passes on capital-gains tax), construction or renovation, and a realistic holding reserve. The
      tables below are indicative 2024–25 market figures; every transaction is different.</p>
    </div>

        </thead>
        <tbody>
          <tr><td><strong>Prime oceanfront land</strong></td><td class="num">C$4,500 – C$21,000+</td><td>Direct beach frontage in established resort towns (El Nido, Boracay, Mactan, Siargao); 300–1,000+ m² lots; scarcity-driven pricing.</td></tr>

          <tr><td><strong>Resort villa (built)</strong></td><td class="num">C$4,500 – C$16,000</td><td>Turnkey 2–4 bedroom beachfront villas; price per m² of floor area, not lot size.</td></tr>

    <p class="tbl-note">Figures exclude transfer taxes and fees. Land prices vary enormously with title status, frontage, access and negotiation. Always benchmark against 3–5 recent comparable sales, not asking prices.</p>

          <tr><td>Transfer tax</td><td class="num">0.5%</td><td class="num">7,000</td><td>Buyer; payable to the local government</td></tr>
          <tr><td>Registration fee</td><td class="num">~0.5%</td><td class="num">7,000</td><td>Registry of Deeds; statutory caps apply for very large values</td></tr>
          <tr><td>Notary, legal & title search</td><td class="num">—</td><td class="num">14,000 – 28,000</td><td>Philippine lawyer, notary, independent title and litigation search, survey</td></tr>

        </tbody>

    </div>
    <p class="tbl-note">If the seller is a VAT-registered developer, 12% VAT is normally embedded in the price and replaces the 6% CGT. Negotiate expressly who pays each tax — this is one of the most negotiable line items in Philippine real estate.</p>
